quests.title: Evermotion Mechanical Painting: Finale

dialogue.t: Ah, bravo! All six Evermotion Mechanical Painting parts, now returned to us! Now then, all we need to do is to splice them together again...
Why, of course! All these six smaller parts can be reunited as one!
Together, they will form a gigantic and beauteous Evermotion Mechanical Painting.
Come, come, all we need to do now is to join them up!

dialogue.sit: Don't we need to cast it or anything?
Is there any other work that needs to be done?

dialogue.t: No, no, not at all. My machine is not some hastily cobbled-together amalgam of scrap!
Every part is wonderfully, intricately meshed together like a... like a... Um...
Eh, never mind. I've never been the best at analogies. I swear Xavier stole all the talent in rhetoric for himself.
Either way, give it a go. It'll be interesting, I guarantee it.
Give it a go yourself. It'll be interesting, I guarantee it.
Perfect! Why, it's lovely! Skilled in both mind and hand, you are, and more so than I could have expected, too!
Hah. I do recall that several ludicrous manuscripts from The Steambird described you as... as...
Heh... As a straight-shooting knight-errant who prefers to let their blade do the talking.
Ah, how ridiculous and foolish those reporters were! How much ado they made about so little! After all, who are you, if not a sharp, smart, humble... and well, straight-shooting knight-errant?
When I get the time, they shall hear from me. Oh yes, they will!
Ah, right. Please take this particular device. You can take it out for a little leisure, should you, well, be at leisure.
As for me, I've got to start raising the Mora I'll need to travel to Liyue...

quests.description: Félix Yogue, someone from the Court of Fontaine, still seems to have things he wants to say…
